sections.name: 阅读理解
sections.note: 每题 2 分。阅读所给文章，从四个选项中选出最佳答案。

passage.title: Tourism that pays for the place
passage.text: Tourism is often described as an export industry: visitors arrive, spend, and leave. The description hides a cost. A small town that attracts a million visitors a year may find its rents rising, its shops turning into souvenir stalls, and its residents moving away. Some destinations now charge an entry fee and use the money to maintain the very streets that visitors come to see. Others limit the number of cruise ships per day. The measures are unpopular with parts of the industry, but they rest on a simple idea: a place that is pleasant to visit must first be pleasant to live in.

sections.name: 翻译
sections.note: 本题 12 分。把划线句子译成汉语，要求准确、通顺。

items.stem: The measures are unpopular with parts of the industry, but they rest on a simple idea: a place that is pleasant to visit must first be pleasant to live in.

answer.text: 这些措施遭到了部分业内人士的反对，但它们基于一个简单的理念：一个宜游的地方，首先必须宜居。

explain.right: 先切分意群定主干，再按汉语习惯重排语序，最后检查术语与指代是否统一。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：be unpopular with 译「遭到……反对」；rest on 译「基于」；冒号引出同位解释；pleasant to visit / to live in 对举，译「宜游」「宜居」最简洁。

sections.name: 写作
sections.note: 本题 12 分。按题目要求写一篇短文。

items.stem: Write an essay of about 150 words on the following topic: some tourist towns now charge an entry fee or limit visitor numbers. Discuss whether such measures are justified.

answer.text: Tourism brings income, but it also raises rents, replaces local shops with souvenir stalls and pushes residents out. An entry fee or a daily limit on visitors looks unwelcoming, yet it addresses a real problem: the town must remain liveable for the people who work there. The revenue can be used to maintain the streets and facilities that visitors come to see, which is precisely what a crowded destination struggles to fund. Such measures are not against tourism; they protect its foundation. The design matters, however: fees should be modest, revenue should be visible in local upkeep, and residents should not be charged for their own town.

explain.right: 先定三段骨架（描述—分析—结论），再把题目给出的信息逐条落进段落，最后检查字数与衔接词。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：只表态「收费不合理」或「游客太多」，没有讨论费用用途与宜居前提。
